why: A living Pokedex needs a second version. With three concurrent Red saves the campaign reaches 140 of 151, and every remaining gap except Mew is a Blue exclusive.

measured_identity.title: POKEMON BLUE
measured_identity.method: read from the owner's cartridge, not transcribed from a reference list

defect_found.what: PyBoyAdapter.start() called verify_rom_bytes(payload) with the Red default, while verify_rom_bytes itself takes the expected cartridge as an argument.
defect_found.consequence: The repository could refuse a cartridge it had explicitly been told to expect. Every check outside the adapter was already selective; the one inside it was not.
defect_found.fix: PyBoyAdapter takes expected_rom, defaulting to Red so no existing caller changes.

first_cross_cartridge_result.observed: The Red adapter loads a Blue cartridge and PokemonRedStateReader.read() returns without error at power-on.
first_cross_cartridge_result.what_this_shows: The ROM gate, the boot path, and the addresses touched at power-on transfer between the two cartridges.
first_cross_cartridge_result.what_this_does_not_show: That the whole memory map transfers. Only the power-on subset was exercised. Verifying the rest means harvesting Blue encounters the same way Red's bands were measured, which the existing pipeline can now do.
first_cross_cartridge_result.note: Red and Blue share one engine, so this outcome was expected. Expected is not measured, and it is now measured.

planning_result: Three concurrent saves suffice, not four. The obvious plan -- three Reds for branch coverage plus a Blue for its exclusives -- buys a whole extra save and reaches exactly the same 150. An earlier estimate in this project said four; it was wrong and the model corrected it.

stated_assumption_not_yet_measured.what: The ten Blue version-exclusives in BLUE_CARTRIDGE_EXCLUSIONS are derived as the complement of Red's ten, not harvested from the Blue cartridge.
stated_assumption_not_yet_measured.why_it_is_marked: That relationship is what makes the pair complete, and a test asserts the two sets do not overlap -- an overlap would mean a species neither cartridge offers, short by that many with no way to notice. But derived is not measured, and the module says so where someone will read it.
stated_assumption_not_yet_measured.how_to_settle_it: Harvest Blue encounters with POKEMON_BLUE_ROM set, exactly as Red's bands were measured.

self_correction: Two of the first three mutation probes against this work passed, meaning two of my own tests were passing for the wrong reason: one left the Red variable unset so a fallback and a correct refusal produced the same error, and one never exercised the adapter's fingerprint wiring at all. Both were rewritten until the mutations turn them red.
